record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare ICICLE_CRASH: Mamoswine (3 stars), Piloswine (2 stars), Swinub (1 star). The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star count. Units not listed are not covered.
record.summary: Deals SPECIAL damage (raw 20/40/80/160 by stars) to every enemy-team unit standing in the 3x3 block of cells centred on the cast target (the target's own cell included). No status is applied and nothing is moved or buffed.

targeting.who: every enemy-team entity on the target's cell and its up to eight neighbouring cells; same-team units and empty cells are skipped
targeting.note: The block is centred on the cast target's position at cast time, not on the caster; the target itself is hit unless it is protected, since its cell is included. Off-board cells are dropped.

geometry.shape: 3x3 square (Chebyshev radius 1) centred on the cast target, centre included, clipped to the board

effects.target: each enemy-team unit in the 3x3 block around the cast target (each cell visited once)
effects.scaling: requested = table[stars-1] per enemy hit, no falloff with distance from the target. handleSpecialDamage: x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost defaults to true); x critPower (reduced by Rocky Helmet / Black Augurite on the hit unit) only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault false, so needs ABILITY_CRIT); x2 once with a DOUBLE_DAMAGE effect; x1.2 with STRANGE_STEAM_BOARD_EFFECT.
effects.resolution: applied = requested after those multipliers; PokemonState.handleDamage then applies attacker/field/weather multipliers, divides by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef), rounds up with a minimum of 1 and lets the shield absorb first; takenDamage = shield damage + HP damage (HP part capped at current hp), 0 when the unit has protect / skydiving / magicBounce. See knowledge/07367c34/core-mechanics.md section A.

starBehavior.note: Damage is indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star value (160, also the ?? fallback) is not reachable by the bare factory star counts. Whether other mechanics raise an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: Which enemies are hit depends on the cast target's coordinates: neighbours on the board edge are clipped, and only units of the other team on those cells are hit.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast spends maxPP of PP and recomputes the 3x3 block from the current target position.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: damage 20/40/80 (1/2/3 stars) per enemy in the 3x3 block. Applied damage = requested x (1 + AP/100) x optional crit / double-damage / steam multipliers, then SPE_DEF division and minimum 1; takenDamage includes shield damage and is 0 for protected units. Big Eater Belt and Twist Band only change the caster's own stat changes and do not touch this damage.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Which unit is the cast target and when the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, silence, targeting) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution - only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate was located

Later handleDamage branches (Shiny Charm, Fossil shield, death handling) and the effects of the frozen status on a unit's actions (the status flag and timer were read, not what a frozen unit is prevented from doing)
Board.cells contents for dead or removed units were not read; the cell values returned by getAdjacentCells are taken as the units currently on the board
unresolved: Which unit is chosen as the cast target in a real fight (targeting by range 1 is not examined)
Whether a unit that dies from an earlier hit in the same cast changes later cells (cell values are read from the board when the cells are collected)
